SELECT f.channel_code, CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN s.store_id ELSE 0 END AS sid, f.vat_rate, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dn, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat,
 sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) calc, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900),
d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT 'dups' k, count(*) a, sum(c) b, NULL x FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'days', count(DISTINCT sale_date), count(*), NULL FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores', count(DISTINCT store_id), NULL, NULL FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'vat_mismatch', count(*), sum(abs(gross_amount-net_amount-round(net_amount*vat_rate,2))), NULL FROM l WHERE abs(gross_amount-net_amount-net_amount*vat_rate)>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_zero', count(*), sum(net_amount), NULL FROM l WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'in_stg', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount), NULL FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'no_dimdate', count(*), NULL, NULL FROM l WHERE sale_date NOT IN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date)

SELECT 'ts_vs_date' k, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount-net_amount) v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', f.sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) <> f.sale_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ts_in_period_date_out', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', f.sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'nontrading_days', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND NOT d.is_trading_day

calls.statement:
SELECT 'final' k, f.vat_rate, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) vat, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', r.vat_rate, sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net), sum(r.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY r.vat_rate
ORDER BY 1, 2
